The harness does not look up or enforce lifecycle-manifest registration for either projection value. The parent must already exist, be root-owned, symlink-free, group/other-nonwritable and non-readable, and worker-traversable in a 0711-safe form with traversable ancestors. NGINX_DOCROOT_PROJECTION_ROOT must be an exact fresh direct child. The projection helper validates but does not create, chown, or chmod the external parent; it creates only the direct child, copies the allowlisted static files, and makes that child worker-traversable.
